entries.name: Accordion
entries.job: Show and hide sections of text so a long page stays short.
entries.use: A page answers several questions and most readers need only one: FAQs, request headers, response body, timing.

entries.name: Agent
entries.job: Lay out a whole agent screen: past sessions, the thread and a docked composer.
entries.use: The product is a conversation with an agent and the screen is the agent: ask, watch it work, read the answer.

entries.name: Agent
entries.job: Chat with /agent while it searches, reads and extracts in the open.
entries.use: Chat with /agent while it searches, reads and extracts in the open.

entries.name: Announce
entries.job: Mark a launch or milestone with one full-width accent panel.
entries.use: A launch, milestone or release is the headline of the page and gets one hero moment.

entries.name: Answer without signing in
entries.job: Approve or decline from an email link: a brief, a reason, a held send, then Undo.
entries.use: A decision is sent to someone by email or chat and one tap should settle it.

entries.name: API keys
entries.job: Create, scope, rotate and revoke keys without leaving the table.
entries.use: Create, scope, rotate and revoke keys without leaving the table.

entries.name: App
entries.job: Frame every signed-in screen with a sidebar, a top bar and a page.
entries.use: The product has several screens that share navigation, an account and a top bar.

entries.name: Approval Bar
entries.job: Ask whether the agent may run an action, with allow once, always allow and deny.
entries.use: The agent wants to do something that costs credits or touches data and a person must say yes first.

entries.name: Sign in and create account
entries.job: Social, email and magic-link sign-in with a quiet art panel.
entries.use: Social, email and magic-link sign-in with a quiet art panel.

entries.name: Sign in, centred
entries.job: The brand, one card and one quiet line, centred on the dot grid. For sign-in, consent and results.
entries.use: The brand, one card and one quiet line, centred on the dot grid. For sign-in, consent and results.

entries.name: Avatar
entries.job: Show who or what something belongs to with initials or a picture.
entries.use: A row, comment or card needs the person or team it belongs to.

entries.name: Back
entries.job: Return to the one obvious previous place.
entries.use: A detail or a result screen has one parent to return to.

entries.name: Badge
entries.job: Label something with a short word or a count.
entries.use: A name or a number needs a short qualifier: plan, role, count, "New", "Beta".

entries.name: Banner
entries.job: Tell the whole account something once, in a strip under the top bar.
entries.use: A fact applies to every screen: trial ends in 3 days, payment failed, maintenance tonight.

entries.name: Bars
entries.job: Rank items by size: credits by endpoint, requests by key.
entries.use: A ranking of a few to a dozen items with exact figures.

entries.name: Blank
entries.job: The smallest correct page: shell, frame, hero and one empty band.
entries.use: The smallest correct page: shell, frame, hero and one empty band.

entries.name: Brand
entries.job: Sign a surface with the product mark and name, an uploaded logo or a wordmark.
entries.use: The top of the sidebar or a centred screen needs the product identity.

entries.name: Breadcrumb
entries.job: Show where this screen sits and jump to a parent.
entries.use: A screen is three or more levels deep and people need to go up to any parent.

entries.name: Button
entries.job: Start an action or confirm a choice with one press.
entries.use: An action runs on this page and nothing navigates: save, create, send, copy, retry.

entries.name: Callout
entries.job: Tell the reader what happened and what to do, next to the content it is about.
entries.use: A form or section needs a warning, a tip or a result right beside it.

entries.name: Card
entries.job: Group the parts of one object on a quiet surface.
entries.use: One object (a key, a team, a plan, a provider) has a title, some facts and an action.

entries.name: Catalog
entries.job: Browse data providers by category and open one to see what it returns.
entries.use: Browse data providers by category and open one to see what it returns.

entries.name: Chart
entries.job: See how values change over time or between periods.
entries.use: A value moves continuously over time: use line, or area for volume.

entries.name: Chat
entries.job: Talk with an AI assistant and a support person in one thread, with rich replies.
entries.use: Customers ask for help from inside the product or on docs and marketing pages.

entries.name: Chat launcher
entries.job: Open and close the chat from a floating button with an unread count.
entries.use: The chat floats over the page and needs a button that is always in reach.

entries.name: Chat lightbox
entries.job: View a chat image full size and step through the others.
entries.use: A chat message holds images and people should see them larger.

entries.name: Chat message
entries.job: Show who said what in a chat, and carry blocks such as forms, cards and approvals.
entries.use: A support or help chat shows turns from the person, the AI, an agent and the system.

entries.name: Checkbox
entries.job: Tick one or more options, or a yes that saves with the form.
entries.use: Several options may be chosen from a fixed set.

entries.name: Checklist
entries.job: Pick several values from a long list, with search and counts.
entries.use: People filter by several values out of a long list: endpoints, keys, statuses.

entries.name: Chip Nav
entries.job: Browse a catalogue by category.
entries.use: A catalogue, gallery or template list is narrowed by category.

entries.name: Choice
entries.job: Choose from options that each need a title and a sentence.
entries.use: Plans, permission levels or modes where each option needs explaining.

entries.name: Code block
entries.job: Show code a developer will read or paste, with copy, line numbers and language tabs.
entries.use: A request, a config or a response is shown in docs or a detail panel.

entries.name: Codefield
entries.job: Edit raw code or JSON that has to be valid.
entries.use: An expert overrides configuration by hand and the value is JSON.

entries.name: Codes
entries.job: Show one-time recovery codes once, with copy and download.
entries.use: Two-step sign-in has just been set up and the person must save backup codes.

entries.name: Color
entries.job: Enter a colour with a picker or a hex code and see how it reads on the page.
entries.use: A brand or accent colour is entered by a person, as in branding or theme settings.

entries.name: Column
entries.job: Keep a narrow block readable on a wide page.
entries.use: A form, an article or an empty state sits on a wide page and should not stretch.

entries.name: Combobox
entries.job: Pick from a long list by typing to filter it.
entries.use: The list is long enough that people need to type to find an item.

entries.name: Command
entries.job: Jump to a page or run an action by typing, from anywhere.
entries.use: An app has many pages and actions and power users want the keyboard.

entries.name: Reason and commit
entries.job: Take a reason and commit a decision with buttons named for their effect.
entries.use: A decision needs a reason that someone reads later: the audit log, the requester, the agent.

entries.name: Composer
entries.job: Ask the agent for something and attach context, sources and a model.
entries.use: The person writes a prompt for an agent and may choose a model, sources or files.

entries.name: Confirm
entries.job: Make someone type a name before a destructive action runs.
entries.use: Deleting a team, project or workspace along with its keys, monitors and logs.

entries.name: Confirm Inline
entries.job: Make someone type a name on the page before a destructive button works.
entries.use: A destructive action has its own page: delete a workspace, approve a restore.

entries.name: Copy Field
entries.job: Show a value people copy, such as an address or an ID.
entries.use: A webhook URL, endpoint, ID or an invite link is shown for copying.

entries.name: Data Card
entries.job: Show one figure with its context and keep the detail one click away.
entries.use: One number matters most and its breakdown belongs behind a click: credits left, balance, quota.

entries.name: Date picker
entries.job: Choose a start and an end date, with presets for the usual ranges.
entries.use: A log, a chart or a report is filtered by a time range.

entries.name: Datefield
entries.job: Enter one date by typing it or picking it from a calendar.
entries.use: A form needs one date: pause until, expires on, start on.

entries.name: Decision brief
entries.job: Show what a decision changes, who it touches, the evidence and who signs, so a person can decide in seconds.
entries.use: A person must approve or decline something that costs money, grants access or ships a change.

entries.name: Decision case
entries.job: One wide-reaching change: the evidence, who it touches, a held commit, then the record.
entries.use: A change reaches many teams or records, and its reach depends on what the person chooses.

entries.name: Decisions
entries.job: Requests and agent proposals by kind, each case beside the list, with ten seconds to undo.
entries.use: Several requests or agent proposals wait for one person or role: credits, hosts, limits, changes.

entries.name: Delta
entries.job: Show a value before and after a change, with an arrow between them.
entries.use: A decision or a preview changes a number, a plan or a scope and both values matter.

entries.name: Dialog
entries.job: Stop the page until the person finishes or dismisses one task.
entries.use: The task must finish or be dismissed before the page makes sense again: create a key, choose providers.

entries.name: Diff
entries.job: Show what a change does before it is saved.
entries.use: A monitor edit, a schema migration or a prompt change is reviewed before saving.

entries.name: Divider
entries.job: Separate two groups with a hairline.
entries.use: Two groups in a toolbar or a menu need a quiet break.

entries.name: Documentation page
entries.job: Build a documentation site in the product's own look: nav, article, contents and footer.
entries.use: The product has guides, SDK pages and an API reference that should read like the product.

entries.name: Doc Ask
entries.job: Point readers to the assistant at the end of a docs section.
entries.use: A docs section ends and an assistant has read the pages and can answer in the reader's language.

entries.name: Doc Cards
entries.job: Fan out from an overview to the pages beneath it with link cards.
entries.use: A docs overview or an intro page leads to three to six places to read next.

entries.name: Doc Changelog
entries.job: List dated releases on a rail with filters by kind or area.
entries.use: Product changes need a public history people can scan and filter.

entries.name: API reference
entries.job: Document an API endpoint: parameters on the left, request and response on the right.
entries.use: An API reference needs the endpoint, its parameters and examples side by side.

entries.name: Doc Frame
entries.job: Show a screenshot, video or diagram in a captioned frame that can open larger.
entries.use: A docs page shows a screen of the product or a demo video.

entries.name: Setup steps
entries.job: Get a reader connected by choosing their tool, with the steps for it below.
entries.use: The same setup differs by tool and the reader needs only their own.

entries.name: API reference
entries.job: An endpoint reference with parameters on the left and sticky request and response panels on the right.
entries.use: An endpoint reference with parameters on the left and sticky request and response panels on the right.

entries.name: Changelog
entries.job: Dated releases on a rail with tags, filters and media frames.
entries.use: Dated releases on a rail with tags, filters and media frames.

entries.name: Guide
entries.job: A long-form guide with the setup card, framed code groups, callouts, steps and a contents column.
entries.use: A long-form guide with the setup card, framed code groups, callouts, steps and a contents column.

entries.name: Docs home
entries.job: A landing page with a large search, start-here cards, the endpoint grid and popular guides.
entries.use: A landing page with a large search, start-here cards, the endpoint grid and popular guides.

entries.name: Donut
entries.job: Show parts of a whole, or one value against a known end.
entries.use: A share of a whole has two to five parts: requests by endpoint, credits by team.

entries.name: Drafted text
entries.job: Offer words an agent wrote for a person, which stay the agent's until the person uses them.
entries.use: An agent drafted the reason or the answer for a decision a person signs.

entries.name: Empty
entries.job: Say what will appear here and give the one action that fills it.
entries.use: A list, table or page has no items yet and the next step is clear.

entries.name: Endpoint
entries.job: Name an API call by its method and path wherever it appears.
entries.use: A docs heading, a log row or a usage table names an endpoint.

entries.name: Fab
entries.job: Keep one primary action in reach while the page scrolls.
entries.use: One action is useful on every part of a long screen, such as opening support.

entries.name: Feature list
entries.job: List what a plan or product includes, one line each with an icon.
entries.use: A pricing card or plan lists what is included and what is not.

entries.name: Field
entries.job: Give a control a label, a hint and room for one error.
entries.use: Any input, textarea, select or custom control that needs a visible label.

entries.name: File upload
entries.job: Add files by dropping them or browsing.
entries.use: People attach one or several files, such as a sitemap, a CSV or a document.

entries.name: Filter
entries.job: Narrow a table or a list by one value, shown as a chip that opens a menu.
entries.use: A table or log has a few filterable columns: status, endpoint, key.

entries.name: Form
entries.job: Lay out fields and actions in a form that stays readable.
entries.use: A settings or create page holds several fields with a Save action.

entries.name: Register an app
entries.job: A long create form in sections: choices, switches, lists and pairs, with no JSON in sight.
entries.use: A long create form in sections: choices, switches, lists and pairs, with no JSON in sight.

entries.name: Form Section
entries.job: Group the fields of a long form under a title.
entries.use: A create or edit form has more than one group: Basics, Callbacks, Access, Advanced.

entries.name: Grid
entries.job: Lay out equal columns that fill the width and reflow.
entries.use: Cards, stats or fields sit in equal columns that should reflow on phones.

entries.name: Grow
entries.job: Let one child take the space left over in a row.
entries.use: A title should push its actions to the far end of a row.

entries.name: Heatgrid
entries.job: See activity over weeks, one cell per day, or an outcome per day.
entries.use: Activity over weeks or months: requests, commits, runs per day.

entries.name: Held action
entries.job: Wait a few seconds before an action goes, with a countdown and Undo.
entries.use: Sending is hard to take back: money, access, a message, a shipped change, a cancelled run.

entries.name: Hovercard
entries.job: Preview a link's target, such as a person or a provider, without leaving the page.
entries.use: A name in a table or sentence links to a person, provider or run and a quick look saves a click.

entries.name: Icon
entries.job: Draw a small symbol beside a label or on a button.
entries.use: A button, menu item or status needs a symbol to scan faster.

entries.name: Impact
entries.job: Say how much a change will touch, before anyone commits it.
entries.use: A change reaches more than the one thing on screen: a plan default, a crawl setting, a policy.

entries.name: Initial
entries.job: Show an organisation's first letter as a dot-matrix mark where it has no logo.
entries.use: An organisation, team or brand has no uploaded logo and needs a mark in the brand slot, a tile or an avatar.

entries.name: Inline code
entries.job: Mark a command, a path or a key inside a sentence.
entries.use: A sentence names a file, a flag, an endpoint or a value.

entries.name: Input
entries.job: Type one line of text, a URL, a key or a number.
entries.use: The value is a short line of free text: a name, an email, a URL, a slug.

entries.name: Input Group
entries.job: Put an icon, prefix, unit or button inside one field.
entries.use: A fixed part of a URL, a currency or a unit sits beside the value (https://, USD, ms).

entries.name: Add Ember to your agent
entries.job: A guided setup that gets a coding agent calling Ember in three steps.
entries.use: A guided setup that gets a coding agent calling Ember in three steps.

entries.name: JSON viewer
entries.job: Explore a JSON response by folding it, not by reading it whole.
entries.use: A response is explored rather than copied whole.

entries.name: Kv
entries.job: Read what an object is as labelled values in a grid.
entries.use: A detail panel, sheet or card shows the facts of one record.

entries.name: Legend
entries.job: Say which colour means which series.
entries.use: A chart has two or more series and readers need to know which is which.

entries.name: List
entries.job: Show rows that are mostly text with one action each.
entries.use: Members, integrations or files with a name, a line of detail and one action.

entries.name: List and detail
entries.job: Work through a queue: pick a record from a list and read or act on it beside the list.
entries.use: People decide or review records one after another: requests, approvals, failures, messages.

entries.name: Listbox
entries.job: Show a list of options a person can choose from.
entries.use: Building a picker or menu whose rows are choices with state (selected, active).

entries.name: Loader
entries.job: Show that something small is loading with a ring, dots, bars or a text frame.
entries.use: A control, a small panel or one line of text is waiting on a response.

entries.name: Log
entries.job: Watch a stream of lines and search them without losing your place.
entries.use: A job, a crawl or a deployment writes lines as it runs.

entries.name: Activity logs
entries.job: Every request with filters, a detail sheet and exportable rows.
entries.use: Every request with filters, a detail sheet and exportable rows.

entries.name: Matrix
entries.job: Set one switch for each category and channel in a grid.
entries.use: Notification settings: events down the side, email, browser and phone across the top.

entries.name: Menu
entries.job: Pick an action or a choice from a short list that belongs to one trigger.
entries.use: A row or a header has a set of actions behind a "more" button.

entries.name: Message
entries.job: Show one turn of an agent conversation: the person in a bubble, the agent in prose.
entries.use: A thread shows what the person asked and what the agent answered.

entries.name: Meter
entries.job: Show how much of a limit is used.
entries.use: A quota, a credit balance or a rate limit has a cap.

entries.name: Mobile Nav
entries.job: Open the full navigation as a sheet on a phone.
entries.use: The sidebar is hidden below 900px and people still need every destination.

entries.name: Monitor the web
entries.job: Pages you watch, how often, and what changed since the last run.
entries.use: Pages you watch, how often, and what changed since the last run.

entries.name: Not found and system states
entries.job: 404, error, offline, plan-locked and maintenance pages.
entries.use: 404, error, offline, plan-locked and maintenance pages.

entries.name: Notification
entries.job: Read the list of things that happened, with the unread ones marked.
entries.use: A bell opens a list of finished jobs, monitor changes and billing alerts.

entries.name: Number
entries.job: Enter a number and nudge it up or down.
entries.use: The value is a count or an amount with limits: retries, page depth, seats.

entries.name: Onboarding
entries.job: A four-step first run: team, goals, API key and a live first call.
entries.use: A four-step first run: team, goals, API key and a live first call.

entries.name: One-time code
entries.job: Enter a short code from a message or an app.
entries.use: A verification code arrives by SMS, email or an authenticator app.

entries.name: Overview
entries.job: The first screen after sign-in: credits, recent runs and the next thing to try.
entries.use: The first screen after sign-in: credits, recent runs and the next thing to try.

entries.name: Page
entries.job: Lay a page out as a drafted column cut into bands by hairlines.
entries.use: Any screen in the app: one band for the title, one for the toolbar, one for the content.

entries.name: Page Head
entries.job: Title a working page and put its actions at the end of the row.
entries.use: A working page, such as a table of runs or a tool, needs a title, a line and one or two actions.

entries.name: Page Hero
entries.job: Open a top-level screen with a tall title band and one line about it.
entries.use: A top-level screen, such as Monitoring or Settings, opens a section of the product.

entries.name: Pagebar
entries.job: Show that a page is navigating or reloading with a thin bar at the top.
entries.use: A route change or a full reload takes a moment and the page has nothing of its own to show yet.

entries.name: Pagination
entries.job: Move through a list that is split into pages.
entries.use: A log, table or result list is split into pages of fixed size.

entries.name: Pairs
entries.job: Edit a set of names with values as rows.
entries.use: The value is a map: scopes, headers, labels, environment variables.

entries.name: Panel
entries.job: Hold a titled group of content, or a 320px pane of sessions beside the rail.
entries.use: Details sit beside the thing they describe and need a head.

entries.name: Parse a file
entries.job: Drop documents, review pages and credits, then parse them.
entries.use: Drop documents, review pages and credits, then parse them.

entries.name: Period
entries.job: Choose a reporting period and what to compare it with.
entries.use: A report, chart or stats row shows a figure and how it changed against an earlier period.

entries.name: Pipeline
entries.job: See what ran, what runs in parallel and what comes after, for one run.
entries.use: A crawl, deploy, data job or agent plan has stages and parallel jobs.

entries.name: Plan
entries.job: Show a pricing plan as a row in billing or a card in a pricing grid.
entries.use: A pricing page compares tiers side by side.

entries.name: Playground
entries.job: Try one capability of a data source with a request form and a response panel.
entries.use: One endpoint or tool has parameters and people want to try it before writing code.

entries.name: Playground
entries.job: Request on the left, response on the right, one page for every endpoint.
entries.use: Request on the left, response on the right, one page for every endpoint.

entries.name: Popover
entries.job: Show richer content than a list next to its trigger: a summary, a small form, a picker.
entries.use: A trigger opens a summary, a few fields or a picker that does not warrant a dialog.

entries.name: Preview then commit
entries.job: Edit a value, see what the change will touch, then commit it with a reason.
entries.use: Changing a default, a limit or a policy that applies to many teams at once.

entries.name: Progress
entries.job: Show work moving to done: a crawl, an import, a run.
entries.use: A job runs and the reader should see how far it has got.

entries.name: Prose
entries.job: Style rendered Markdown or long text without adding classes.
entries.use: The content is Markdown or CMS output that you do not control the markup of.

entries.name: Provider
entries.job: One provider in depth: endpoints, parameters and a live request.
entries.use: One provider in depth: endpoints, parameters and a live request.

entries.name: QR code
entries.job: Let someone scan a code with a phone to pair a device or add an authenticator.
entries.use: Pairing a phone or device with an account.

entries.name: Decision queue
entries.job: Work through what waits for a decision, one case at a time, beside the list.
entries.use: Several requests or agent proposals wait for one person: credits, hosts, access, changes.

entries.name: Radio
entries.job: Choose exactly one option from a few.
entries.use: One of 2 to 4 options is saved with the form and each has a short label.

entries.name: Reason
entries.job: Show why a control is off and who can turn it on.
entries.use: A permission, plan or state turns a control off and the person needs to know what to do.

entries.name: Reasoning
entries.job: Fold away the plan behind an answer for the person who wants to check it.
entries.use: The agent's approach is worth showing but most people will skip it.

entries.name: Team record
entries.job: One team on one page: status, lifecycle, usage, requests and plan, each loading on its own.
entries.use: One customer, team, key or project needs a single page that gathers its state, history and actions.

entries.name: Result
entries.job: Show the data an agent returned as a table, with a JSON view and a cost line.
entries.use: The agent's answer is rows of data the person may copy, export or inspect.

entries.name: Row
entries.job: Put things side by side with even space.
entries.use: Children sit on one line: a title and its actions, a field and a button.

entries.name: Run Steps
entries.job: Show the plan of a long run and tick it off as it goes.
entries.use: A run takes minutes and the person wants to see the plan and where it is.

entries.name: Running
entries.job: Show how many jobs are in progress and open the list from the top bar.
entries.use: Work continues after the page that started it: crawls, agent runs, monitor checks, imports.

entries.name: Schema
entries.job: Document the parameters of an endpoint: names, types, defaults and nested fields.
entries.use: An API reference lists request parameters or response fields.

entries.name: Screen
entries.job: Centre one task on a page of its own, outside the shell.
entries.use: The person does one thing before entering the app: sign in, verify, consent, finish a flow.

entries.name: Scroller
entries.job: Scroll a row of cards sideways with snapping and arrows.
entries.use: A short shelf of featured or recommended cards sits above a longer catalogue.

entries.name: Search
entries.job: Search a list or a page by typing.
entries.use: People filter or find items in a list, table or document.

entries.name: Secret
entries.job: Show or enter a secret that stays masked until asked.
entries.use: An API key or signing secret is shown with reveal and copy.

entries.name: Segmented
entries.job: Pick one of two to five options that change what you see here.
entries.use: Two to five mutually exclusive options change the view in place: All, Mine, Archived.

entries.name: Select
entries.job: Choose one option from a list in a native menu.
entries.use: One value comes from a list of roughly 5 to 15 plain labels: country, region, time zone.

entries.name: Service Status
entries.job: Show whether the product is healthy: an icon when normal, a labelled pill when not.
entries.use: People depend on the service and should see an incident without looking for a status page.

entries.name: Session List
entries.job: Pick up an earlier agent session, or start a new one.
entries.use: An agent keeps history and people return to earlier runs.

entries.name: Setting
entries.job: Put one setting on a row: what it is on the left, its control on the right.
entries.use: A settings page lists preferences, each with a switch, select or button.

entries.name: Settings
entries.job: Account, team, billing and notifications behind one side nav.
entries.use: Account, team, billing and notifications behind one side nav.

entries.name: Sheet
entries.job: Show the detail of something picked from a list without losing the list.
entries.use: A row in a table or a log opens its full detail beside the list.

entries.name: Shell, server-rendered
entries.job: The whole app shell as plain markup, with no shell.js: copy it when a server renders your pages.
entries.use: The whole app shell as plain markup, with no shell.js: copy it when a server renders your pages.

entries.name: Shortcuts
entries.job: Go to a page by keyboard and list every shortcut in a sheet.
entries.use: People return to the same few pages all day: an app with a sidebar of destinations.

entries.name: Sidebar
entries.job: Move between the product's sections from a list on the left.
entries.use: The app has more than three destinations people move between all day.

entries.name: Skeleton
entries.job: Hold a place for content that is loading, with the same shape as the real thing.
entries.use: A region has a known layout and its data is on the way.

entries.name: Slider
entries.job: Pick a position on a scale by dragging.
entries.use: The value is a position on a scale and a rough setting is enough: effort, volume, depth.

entries.name: Snippet
entries.job: Copy one command or one value, or follow a short list of numbered commands.
entries.use: A reader leaves with one command: install, login, run.

entries.name: Sources
entries.job: Show where an answer came from, with numbered citations and a list of sources.
entries.use: An agent's claims come from pages and the person should be able to check each one.

entries.name: Sparkline
entries.job: Show the direction of a number in a few pixels beside it.
entries.use: A stat tile, table cell or list row shows a number and its recent trend.

entries.name: Split
entries.job: Put details beside the thing they describe, in two columns.
entries.use: A list or run needs a details panel beside it.

entries.name: Stack
entries.job: Put things one above another with even space.
entries.use: Children sit one above another: a heading, text and a button.

entries.name: Page states
entries.job: Show the one state a screen or a section is in: loading, ready, empty, error, no access and the rest.
entries.use: Any screen or section that loads its own data.

entries.name: Stats
entries.job: Read a few headline numbers at a glance, as one joined strip.
entries.use: The top of a page shows three to six numbers: credits, requests, success rate.

entries.name: Status
entries.job: Show the state of a run, a monitor or a key with a dot and a word.
entries.use: A row needs the state of a thing: Running, Passed, Failed, Paused.

entries.name: Steps
entries.job: Show where someone is in a flow with a fixed order, or how far live work or a record has got.
entries.use: A setup or create flow has a fixed order: choose pages, schedule, notify, review.

entries.name: Subnav
entries.job: Move between settings pages from a side column.
entries.use: A settings or account area has four or more pages and a column beside them.

entries.name: Suggestions
entries.job: Offer example prompts that fill the composer when clicked.
entries.use: The empty state of an agent needs to show what it can do.

entries.name: Support
entries.job: A help centre with the chat as a full-page inbox: Ember AI first, a person when you need one.
entries.use: A help centre with the chat as a full-page inbox: Ember AI first, a person when you need one.

entries.name: Swatch
entries.job: Show a colour that is content, such as a brand colour or a series colour.
entries.use: A brand, series or tag colour appears beside its name or hex value.

entries.name: Switch
entries.job: Turn a setting on or off, with the change applying at once.
entries.use: A setting takes effect the moment it flips: notifications, a feature flag, a preference.

entries.name: Table
entries.job: Compare, sort and act on records laid out in rows and columns.
entries.use: People compare the same fields across many records: logs, keys, invoices, runs.

entries.name: Tabs
entries.job: Switch between views of the same object.
entries.use: One object has several views: the output formats of a run, the sections of a record.

entries.name: Tag
entries.job: Mark or filter something by category with a small pill.
entries.use: Items carry categories, topics or labels people can click to filter.

entries.name: Tag input
entries.job: Enter a free-form list of values, one token each.
entries.use: The list is free text: domains, IP ranges, emails, keywords, redirect URIs.

entries.name: Text
entries.job: Change the tone or length of a piece of text.
entries.use: A line is secondary: a hint, a timestamp, a caption.

entries.name: Textarea
entries.job: Write an answer that runs over several lines.
entries.use: The answer is a sentence or more: a description, a prompt, a note.

entries.name: Texture
entries.job: Add a quiet generated field of characters, dots or marks behind a hero, banner or empty state.
entries.use: A page hero, a launch banner or an empty state needs depth without adding anything to read.

entries.name: Thread
entries.job: Hold the turns of an agent conversation in order.
entries.use: An agent screen needs the container for its messages and the work between them.

entries.name: Tile
entries.job: Hold a logo, a glyph or one or two letters in a square.
entries.use: A row or card needs a mark for what it is: a provider, an integration, a key type.

entries.name: Timeline
entries.job: Read the history of one thing as a list of events in time order.
entries.use: A run, a key or a deployment needs its history shown newest first or oldest first.

entries.name: Toast
entries.job: Confirm something that already happened, then get out of the way.
entries.use: An action finished and needs a quiet receipt: key copied, saved, deleted.

entries.name: Toc
entries.job: List the sections of a long page and follow the reader.
entries.use: A long documentation or reference page has several sections.

entries.name: Toolbar
entries.job: Search, filter and act on a list, with controls wrapping instead of scrolling.
entries.use: A table, list or grid needs search, filters and one create action.

entries.name: Toolcall
entries.job: Show one step the agent took, with its arguments, time and cost.
entries.use: The agent calls tools and the person may want to check what ran.

entries.name: Tooltip
entries.job: Name an icon-only control or reveal its shortcut on hover or focus.
entries.use: An icon-only button needs a name.

entries.name: Topbar
entries.job: Switch teams, reach help and docs, and take the one primary action.
entries.use: Every screen in the shell needs the team, help and one upgrade or create action in the same place.

entries.name: Tweaks
entries.job: Change the whole look of the product live: palette, type, tone, density, corners and motion.
entries.use: A team is choosing a product's character before committing to it.

entries.name: Type
entries.job: Set the size and weight of a heading, label or body text.
entries.use: Any heading, label or paragraph needs a step on the scale.

entries.name: Usage
entries.job: Credits, success rates, concurrency and a 20-week activity grid.
entries.use: Credits, success rates, concurrency and a 20-week activity grid.

entries.name: Use Agent
entries.job: Offer to add the product to the person's own agent or coding tool.
entries.use: The product can run inside the person's own agent and you want a visible entry to setup.

entries.name: Utilities
entries.job: Hide text from sight but keep it for screen readers, or add a small motion.
entries.use: A control or heading needs a name that sighted users read from context (fd-sr-only).

entries.name: Verified
entries.job: Show that an account or a provider has been verified.
entries.use: A name in a card, a profile or a list belongs to a checked provider or account.

entries.name: Viewswitch
entries.job: Switch the same data between two views, such as a table and its JSON.
entries.use: One result has a Table and a JSON view.
